purpose: Exploratory single-trial screens; accepted production configurations are reported separately. No speedup claim is based on a failed residual check.
initial_vector_note: The early eigen-width screens used the default Warp seed, whose vector depends on ncv; from cg_warm_zero onward, every eigen screen restores the same saved initial vector.
revision_note: The PR update changes a refit validation guard, not the construction/apply paths exercised here.
loop_batching_note: cg_loop runs with batch > 1 use an explicit process-local diagnostic override; final production timing runs use unmodified upstream CG.
